card.description: A coaching staff wants to predict the other team's next play. Each record is one real play from the 2023 NFL season. The label is Pass or Run. A pass throws the ball. A run carries it. You can also choose First Down? or Drive Scored? as the label.
card.source: nflverse play-by-play data, 2023 season (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/pbp). Records hand-picked from real plays.

context.potentialUses: Help a coach guess if the other team will pass or run
context.potentialMisuses: It is trained on a small set of plays picked by people, so it can be wrong in game situations that have only a few records. Don't use it to judge a team or a coach.

fields.description: Which try is this? A team gets four tries (downs) to move the ball 10 yards.
How far does the team need to go for a first down? Short is 1 to 3 yards, Medium is 4 to 6, Long is 7 or more.
Is the team with the ball winning, tied or losing?
Did the play earn a first down (or a touchdown)?
Did the team score (a touchdown or field goal) before the other team got the ball?
Did the team Pass or Run? This is what the model predicts.
